title: VIXEN build gates stale FrameTargets schema after full compilation
body: The queued merged-tip build failed at the final frame_targets_schema_check after compiling/linking the entire 455-step graph because VIXEN/codegen/generated/gpu/frame-targets.schemas.json was stale. Recovery required a separate queued cmake --build build/wsl --target frame_targets_refresh -j2, then a second full build. Suggested consolidation: make build-wsl or the codegen target refresh the generated schema before the drift check, or establish the refresh target as an explicit dependency so a fresh build cannot spend the full compile before discovering stale generated input.

title: Queued witness wrapper can stall on shared history lock after payload completion
body: The live queue payloads completed and produced evidence, but the with-test-lock wrapper remained blocked in flock -x on /tmp/undertow-box-history.lock while unrelated lane jobs held the shared history path. I had to terminate only my own completed wrapper PIDs to continue, while preserving the payload logs and outcomes. Suggested consolidation: make post-job history recording non-blocking or bounded, and expose payload completion independently so a completed build/test cannot hold a lane and appear hung behind unrelated history writers.

title: VIXEN build discovers stale merged SDI header only after full compilation
body: The first queued merged-tip build failed late with 1 merged SDI header out of date and required the manual command build/wsl/bin/sdi_tool merge-variants VIXEN/shaders/sdi-variants.json before the build could pass. Suggested consolidation: make build-wsl invoke or depend on the declared SDI merge generation before the drift check, so a clean build does not compile the full graph against stale merged shader metadata.

title: Lookdev capture requires GPU-resource admission and explicit shared-driver environment
body: The first canonical 2000^2 capture was admitted as a generic test job and failed Vulkan initialization with VK_ERROR_INCOMPATIBLE_DRIVER while another capped GPU capture was active. Recovery required rerunning under the gpu queue resource with the shared VK_LAYER_PATH and LD_LIBRARY_PATH. Suggested consolidation: make the capture CTest/producer contract declare the GPU resource and inject the shared driver environment, so a valid capture is not sensitive to generic test admission or hand-copied loader variables.
